instruction.text: Find the pan lid in the image.

feedback.end: There are lots of water droplets on the inside of the pan lid. This happens because of condensation. The steam from cooking has turned back into a liquid after touching the cooler surface of the lid.

instruction.text: When it is cold, it is possible to see your breath when you breathe out. Select the cloud to find out why.

feedback.end: When the air is cool, the water vapour in your breath changes from a gas to a liquid. This creates a visible cloud.

instruction.text: Drag the ice cubes to the glass of water to see what happens when the glass is cooled on this warm summer day.
Drops of water have appeared on the outside of the glass. Fill in the gaps to explain what is happening.

atoms.b: As the ((++warm cold)) air outside the glass comes into contact with the ((warm ++cold)) surface of the glass, the water vapour in the air cools down.
As it cools, the vapour ((++condenses evaporates)) into water droplets on the glass.
